verdict.rationale: Airwallex has a Bills API for creating/managing vendor invoices and an AgentOS toolkit for AI agents to act on account data (balances, beneficiaries, cashflow reports), but no evidence describes AI reading/parsing incoming bill documents (e.g., OCR/extraction) to auto-populate payment fields for review. Missing for 10: any documentation of automated bill-reading/data-extraction capability tied to AI, and any example of pre-filled payment review workflow.
